text: I'd like to call today's police station meeting to order, special meeting for relations to sergeant, on July 27th. First, I'd like to go on to the second session. I'll take a motion to do so. So moved. Second. Any discussion? If not, are your minds all in favor? Aye. Opposed? The ayes have it. We are in the second session and the first officer to be interviewed is Officer Baines, who will be coming to the meeting soon. Second. So moved. Second. We interviewed nine sergeant candidates this evening. I'd like to put in a motion to pick as number one Detective Gabb. So moved. Second. All those in favor, signify by saying aye. Aye. Opposed? The ayes have it. Detective Gabb is number one. I'll put a motion for it on the sheet, or a motion to sergeant for Officer Baines. So moved. Second. All those in favor, signify by saying aye. Aye. Opposed? The ayes have it. Officer Baines is the second sergeant to do tonight. You can close the meeting then. Okay. I'll entertain a motion to adjourn if there's no further business before the commission. So moved.
